title: Charles Edward Wilson Professor of Business Administration Senior Associate Dean for HBS Publishing
bio: Winner of the 2023 HBR Prize for the best article of the year in Harvard Business Review for “Reskilling in the Age of AI” (September–October 2023) with Jorge Tamayo, Leila Doumi, Sagar Goel, and Orsolya Kovács-Ondrejkovic.
